sections.markdown:
## E2 — Competitive teardown: application documents, fees, renewal and address rules
No competitor was reviewed in this pass; names, prices, structure, pedagogy, practice style, praise, complaints and coverage are open (TN-APP-TEARDOWN).
Adopt and beat lists stay empty until at least two named, priced competitors are examined from their own store or review pages.
Angle to test later: competitors may skip the document rules entirely; a bring-these-originals checklist with the day-count deadlines could be a beat point once verified.

corpus_stability.reason: The Tennessee Comprehensive Driver License Manual says its content is current as of July 1, 2022 and its back cover carries one March 2025 print authorization; nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year, but the content date is old, so freshness is held as debt rather than assumed.

verification_debt.claim_text: Competitive teardown of Tennessee permit-test prep products for the application documents, fees, renewal and address rules topic is unresearched.
